import nltk
from nltk.tokenize import word_tokenize

class SimpleNLP:
    def __init__(self, text):
        self.text = text

    def tokenize(self):
        return word_tokenize(self.text)

# Example usage:
nlp = SimpleNLP("Hello, how are you?")
print(nlp.tokenize())
